parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more goal-specific personalization (notably the 529 plan tailored to the education goal) and more concrete, actionable execution steps including specific dollar amounts and sector redeployment targets. System A has stronger factual grounding with fewer unsupported quantitative claims, but B's superior actionability, goal-linked diversification, and explicit addressing of the 10-year education horizon make it the stronger overall response.
